# Native room fixtures

Generated by `research/offline/extend_native_room_fixtures.mjs` from
`validation/release-20261029/room-probe/fixtures/`.

The historical captures ended NPC records at `0xC68`. Current field extraction
reads through `0xF60`, so the generator appends zero bytes only for NPC record
tails that were absent at capture time. `CapturedMemory` still enforces exact
segment bounds and fails on any read outside the generated segment.
